key_insight: Neural triage decoding adaptively allocates computation to decode ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes with near-optimal accuracy and approximately 10–100× lower latency than algorithmic alternatives.
engineering_relevance: Fast, accurate decoding could help high-rate quantum error correction keep pace with hardware while reducing physical-qubit overhead.
method: Predict corrections with a local neural message-passing network.
Use syndrome consistency to trigger extra iterations for unresolved cases.
Rarely invoke a diversification stage to search for consistent corrections.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations on lifted-product and Kasai codes encoding hundreds of logical qubits, with state-of-the-art accuracy, lower latency, and robustness to mismatched error priors.
watch_item: Syndrome consistency does not guarantee logical correctness, and rare diversification cases may complicate worst-case latency guarantees.
paper_title: Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
